configDefinition.name: screen_index
configDefinition.description: 0-based position of this screen in the row (0 = leftmost). Set a different value on each screen.

configDefinition.name: screen_count
configDefinition.description: Total number of screens in the row. Same value on every screen.

configDefinition.name: cycle_ms
configDefinition.description: Time for one full round trip of the ball across the field and back, in milliseconds (default 10000).

configDefinition.name: hop_count
configDefinition.description: Number of bounces during one cycle (whole number; default 10).

configDefinition.name: sync_group
configDefinition.description: Group identifier — screens sharing the same group animate together.

configDefinition.name: sync_server
configDefinition.description: URI of the synchronization server. Leave empty to use the signageOS default server.

configDefinition.name: sync_engine
configDefinition.description: Sync engine: "sync-server" (default) or "p2p-local" for LAN-only. All screens in a group must match.

configDefinition.name: wait_timeout_ms
configDefinition.description: Barrier wait timeout in milliseconds; on timeout the loop retries instead of stalling (default 15000).
